hooks.command: uv run --no-project "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/stale_install_check.py" || { rc=$?; printf 'WARNING: core-hooks stale-install check failed (exit %s)\n' "$rc" >&2; exit 0; }

uv run --no-project "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/safety_guard.py" --host codex || { rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 3 ]; then exit 2; fi; printf 'BLOCKED: core-hooks safety hook failed (exit %s)\n' "$rc" >&2; exit 2; }

uv run --no-project "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/pre_git_hook.py" --host codex || { rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 3 ]; then exit 2; fi; printf 'BLOCKED: core-hooks git policy hook failed (exit %s)\n' "$rc" >&2; exit 2; }
uv run --no-project "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/zsh_traps.py" --host codex || { rc=$?; printf 'WARNING: core-hooks zsh trap hook failed (exit %s)\n' "$rc" >&2; exit 0; }
uv run --no-project "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/post_tool_use.py" || { rc=$?; printf 'WARNING: core-hooks logging hook failed (exit %s)\n' "$rc" >&2; exit 0; }
uv run --no-project "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/system_notification.py" --success || { rc=$?; printf 'WARNING: core-hooks notification hook failed (exit %s)\n' "$rc" >&2; exit 0; }
